text:
Maya: Heads-up — planning to roll new rate-limit thresholds for hosted API v2 tomorrow 12:00 UTC. We'll run a 5% canary in us-west-2 for 15m. Affected surface: per-key soft-limit and burst window. Any blockers?

Alex: Are we changing headers or just enforcement? SDKs need to parse X-RateLimit-... if header format changes.

Javier: Enforcement only. Headers unchanged. Rollout plan: 5% -> 20% (1h) -> 100% (gradual). Canary policy: auto-rollback if >2% increase in 429 rate across canary or any customer gets >5% of their requests 429 in 10m. We'll instrument with rate_limit.429.count and customer.qps.

Priya: Support note — AcmeCorp saw sporadic 429 spikes last Wednesday when they had a short burst. They use long-polling and sometimes burst above quota. Ticket #4521. Repro curl:

```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" "https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate" -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":10}'
# response headers included X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
```

Sam: If canary shows customer-impact, can we failover their traffic to Dedicated? We have a reserved pool for some tier-1 customers.

Javier: Yes — we can route specific API keys to dedicated pool via routing tag `tier:deds`. Need support to coordinate with CSMs for permitted keys. Also adding a short backoff recommendation in runbook: exponential with jitter, start 200ms.

deploy-bot: Starting canary roll: config rate_limit.v2.threshold=1.25x for canary (5% traffic) — https://deploys.redwood/in/2256789012

Maya: Add checklist before canary: 1) alert thresholds set (429 delta), 2) dashboard with top 10 customers by 429, 3) support on standby, 4) rollback command ready.

Alex: Can we log X-RateLimit-* into request traces? Need it in Sentry and DataDog. If not, SDKs will surface bogus errors.

Javier: I'll add headers to tracing and a quick metrics query:

```
sum(rate(rate_limit.429.count[5m])) by (customer_key)
```

Priya: I'll ping AcmeCorp CSM to ask them to throttle long-polling during the window or allow a temporary quota increase.

Maya: Ok let's proceed. If anyone sees >2% uplift in global 429s or any customer >5% 429s in 10m we abort and rollback. Rollback command:

```bash
# rollback to previous config
redwoodctl config set rate_limit.v2.threshold=1.0 --env=prod
redwoodctl deploy rollback --tag=rate-v2-canary-2256789012
```

Sam: I'll be on-call during the window. Will watch ingestion and queue depths.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 5% — monitoring for 30m. Link: https://monitor.redwood/canaries/2256789012

Maya: Thanks — feel free to DM me if you see anything weird. :thumbsup:
